baseline.method: Unmodified author source, normalized floating RGB, Octave 8.4 image 2.14, exact native pumpkins observations; self-comparison is consistency only

reference_type: independently executed standard-method result, not physical truth
threshold_rationale: Fixed source-consistency tolerances: float64 sparse-solve roundoff and uint8 rounding. Source and cleaned image match exactly; measured transmission max absolute difference 1.96e-13. Nonzero bounds permit numerical solver variation, do not assert scene accuracy.
nrmse_definition: For each required output separately, sqrt(mean((estimate-reference)^2))/(max(reference)-min(reference)); no alignment or scale fitting. NCC is flattened cosine similarity without mean subtraction.
